limits: The corrupt-encoding mechanism is new live evidence, but the expected abstention and missing-input rule are known in advance.
The missing-input case tests a CPU-deployment confounder against model-artifact loss; it is not a novel diagnosis class.
The intervention is restricted to new synthetic jobs and must preserve named volumes and restore both input objects in a finally block.
This two-case local check does not estimate population-level root-cause accuracy.
recovery_note: Original runner stopped at a preregistered attempt-code mismatch after restoring inputs; no faults were rerun.
